title: Shared media service: id property ... got undefined

hypotheses.text: whatsapp-web.js injected Utils.js spreads mediaOptions.toJSON() which has an internal id: undefined property, overwriting message.id and causing WhatsApp Web's memoized collection getter to throw 'Data passed to get must include an id property ... but got undefined'.
